chaos_failure_map.store: Primary source of truth; atomic tmp+rename => never corrupt; persist every ~2s
chaos_failure_map.kill_api_sigkill: Acked ops are mirrored BEFORE ack => zero data loss with PG up; worst case (PG also down) only the <=2s unflushed window
chaos_failure_map.redis_down: readiness 503 + liveness 200; reads 200 via L1 cache + memory fallback + single-flight; rate-limit fail-open; OTP state in-memory => zero data loss
chaos_failure_map.pg_down: reads from store unaffected; sync => 200 + audit sync_mirror_failed; only DELETE REST => 500 (tombstone kept, client retry idempotent); readiness 503
chaos_failure_map.net_latency: p95 linear + 65s hard request timeout; client sync queue (offline-first) => delay = UX, zero loss
chaos_failure_map.disk_full: persistStore crash-free (try/catch), audit self-limiting (10MB rotation), corrupt backup never written, GC guards growth => zero crash/500

key_findings.known_limitation: After a long Redis outage, ioredis retryStrategy (3 attempts) is exhausted and the client stays closed => process restart required to re-acquire Redis. Improvement candidate: persistent retryStrategy (k8s: rolling restart after Redis healthy).
